name: product-store
description: This is a full stack (PERN) web application based on the tutorial from the video: [PERN Stack Course: Build a Full Stack Product Store with React and Postgres](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y7kvxIQQxtQ).

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run db:push --prefix backend && npm run start --prefix backend
